target_semantics_lesson: Forecast the specific change threshold for the US 30-year yield, not just general direction. Ensure evidence supports the magnitude required for the binary outcome.
evidence_selection_lesson: Validate each link in the causal chain with current, cutoff-safe evidence. Missing or contradicted evidence weakens the entire bridge to the target.
causal_reasoning_lesson: Connect persistent inflation and hawkish Fed stances to rising long-term yields. Recognize that market volatility and rate hike expectations are key mediators.
counterevidence_lesson: Acknowledge uncertainty when forecast-time data for the specific target period is absent. General trends do not guarantee specific magnitude outcomes.
calibration_lesson: Assess if current evidence supports the magnitude and boundary crossing, not just the direction of the yield change. Audit for dominant counter-paths.
